title: Charleston Historic Pub Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Charleston's historic pub culture with this all-inclusive tour uncovering 350+ years of history and Pub Culture on this expertly guided tour.

Journey through the Historic French Quarter, visiting local pubs where you’ll learn about the city's rich heritage and intriguing tales of Pints, Pubs, Prostitutes, Pirates, and Politics*.

Each tour includes a City-Certified guide, drinks at three pubs, and at least one sharable appetizer to complement your experience. Perfect for culture buffs and beer enthusiasts alike, this tour promises education, entertainment, and enlightenment! 

- Professional guides certified in history and beer (Unique in Charleston!)
- Enjoy craft beer, wine, or cider at three local pubs
- Includes at least one sharable appetizer
- Ideal for guests aged 21 and older, with a maximum of 15-20 minutes of actual walking.

*No Politics after 1940
